source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: My Agent keeps using web_search instead of my specialized database_query tool even though the database tool is available. Why?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate tool-design-principles, audit the database_query tool description for missing when-to-use guidance and unclear boundaries

test_cases.prompt: I have 5 separate tools for reading PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, and TXT files. Should I combine them?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate tool-design-principles, integrate into unified read_document with file_type parameter (functionally similar, same job)

test_cases.prompt: How should I write the description for my send_email tool so the Agent uses it correctly?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate tool-design-principles, describe when-to-use, boundaries (cannot send to unauthorized recipients), concrete parameter examples

test_cases.prompt: How do I add error recovery when my Agent tool calls fail?
How do I organize 200 tools so the Agent can find the right one?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate proactive-tool-discovery or progressive-disclosure-skills, NOT tool-design-principles

test_cases.prompt: I have two tools that do similar things but one is read-only and one writes to a production database. Should I integrate them?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT integrate. Keep separate -- the write tool needs finer-grained permission control and audit trails. The book explicitly states dedicated tools are necessary for operations requiring special permissions.
